newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares tumble, seen soft to mid-April.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares tumble, seen soft to mid-April.

text.p: Zimbabwe's main industrial index crashed some 107.12 points down on Easter eve as investors continued to siphon out funds to stay liquid ahead of new stock issues, brokers said.

The 59-share industrial index closed Thursday at 10,169.97 following losses in some key counters, including hotel chain Zimsun, which traded 10 cents lower at 375, conglomerate Delta and Zimbabwe Newspapers, which traded 25 and 100 cents down respectively at 1,700 and 4,900.
Brokers say they expect the market to continue soft at least up to mid-April when some new issues come onto the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange.
The secondary seven-share mining index slipped 5.09 points to 990.23, pushed down by a 50-cent loss in gold mining company Rio Tinto which traded at 2,600.
